  "to": ["Jack", "Sam"],
  "eagerness": 4,
  "point": [22, 7],
  "do": "stop",
  "notes": "Stroke 2 (belly) is Tom's; I cancelled my queued trace and am not building it unless Tom asks. Maya: tail join and fin edges. Sofia: stroke 3, bottom fin. Priya: top fin and watching START. Leo: holds the pad, laying stroke 1 (back, START at the top of the tail to the nose); the back is still short of the nose. Sam wants the pad after the back is standing, for the dorsal fin. Jack: tail end of the back check. Me: nose join check once the back reaches the nose, and fix on small breaks. Eye label on the pad is still open; I'd take it only if Leo hands the pad over. Don't push until START is joined and the belly is standing."
